text:
tess-sales: Hey team — OrbitBank POC request landed. Key asks: streaming with SSE fallback (corp proxies), structured function/tool calls, schema versioning, on-prem connector (VPC), SAML SSO, offline KMS/HSM. They plan Go edge + Python backend. Also want a short pricing ballpark for 220 qps steady, spikes to 1k. Can we assemble blockers + a one-pager? :wave:

yoel-eng: Sure. Quick q: do they require long-lived connections through the edge adapter, or will the adapter initiate outbound connections?

tess-sales: Edge agent will be outbound (customer-managed host) but inside a locked network — so ephemeral creds + IP allowlist required.

mira-ml: Streaming rec: WS by default, SSE fallback for proxies. For toolcalls we stream incremental tool_call.parts so UI can render partial args/results. Example streamed line for SSE:```json
{"evt":"tool_call.part","id":"orb-17","payload":{"name":"get_balance","partial":"{\"acct\":\"...\"}"}}
```

yoel-eng: Go snippet for ephemeral auth header:
```go
req.Header.Set("Authorization", fmt.Sprintf("Bearer %s", ephemeralToken))
req.Header.Set("X-Req-Id", reqId)
```

infra-bot: Note: Dedicated recommended if sustained >450 qps. Hosted handles burst but unit cost higher. See pricing docs for reserved capacity.

tess-sales: Ballpark for email? They want a quick number to decide whether to pursue Dedicated.

yoel-eng: High-level: hosted pay-as-you-go typically 2-3x per-token vs committed Dedicated. For 220 qps steady, a small Dedicated commit (1-3 GPUs depending on model) + hosted burst is common. Exact depends on model family + quantization; I'll get a tighter range after model choice.

mira-ml: Security/compliance: we have SOC2 + ISO summaries and an HSM connector for Private deployments. For offline KMS tests we can provide test keys and a connector plan. I'll DM the security contact and attach the pen-test note.

yoel-eng: POC blockers checklist: 1) IP allowlist or site-to-site VPN/VPC peering, 2) SAML metadata exchange and test IdP, 3) plan for offline KMS/HSM access or test creds, 4) acceptance prompt set + schema contract, 5) model family choice for cost estimate. If allowlist impossible, we can run a short-lived agent with outbound-only connections.

tess-sales: Please drop the allowlist ranges, SAML steps, ephemeral token examples, dedicated estimator link, and security contact. I'll draft the one-pager and ask for SAML metadata and network owner's contact. Target POC in ~2 weeks pending SAML/network. :calendar:

infra-bot: Reminder: request Dedicated trial early if committing — GPU lead time ~3-4 weeks.

tess-sales: Thanks all :thumbsup:

[thread end]
